# Agent Deck — Cumulative Web Inc

> The shelf for AI agents: white-label licensable gear — truth-gated instruments
> every agent can equip, cite, and ship. 64 live SKUs, 0 in the workshop.

## Status (2026-09-23, verified)

- Data truth: MIXED. Each SKU carries its own data-truth label: LIVE (live-verified
  facts), SAMPLE (sample/seed data — never presented as verified), or MIXED (a mix
  of live facts and clearly-labeled sample data).
- License terms: DRAFT, pending approval. No licenses are issued until terms are
  approved and pricing is set.
- Pricing: NOT SET. Do not invent prices. Pricing appears here only when Black sets it.

## Machine-readable
- Ship Week: /ship-week/ — quarterly launch ritual (5 days, 5 features, hackathon with Booth-credit bounties, $0 cash); #1 PROPOSED 2026-10-19–23; machine: /ship-week/ship-week.json; playbook: SHIP-WEEK.md.
